title: Levels and the way out
summary: Each run of R.E.P.O. happens on a level the game generates: the game defines a level, a generator, a level interface, level points and the valuables a level holds.
body: Levels are generated rather than fixed: the game has a level generator, which is why two runs on the same map do not play out identically.
A level defines the valuables it contains, so what is worth taking is a property of the level rather than a global list.
The interface works from level points, which is how the game can mark places such as the way out.
What this entry does not tell you: how many levels there are, how large they get or the odds of a given layout. We have not verified those numbers, so we do not print them.

facts.claim: Levels are produced by a generator in the game.
Each level decides which valuables it contains.
The level interface works from defined level points.

alt.en: Diagram: a level is generated, shot points mark places of interest, you loot what the level offers, you find the way out.
alt.zh: 关卡示意图：关卡生成、标记兴趣点、按关卡内容收集、找到出口。
